tests.name: Successful Peer-to-Peer Transfer
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, status SUCCESS, Alice debited ₹500, Bob credited ₹500

tests.name: Insufficient Balance Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Insufficient wallet balance'

tests.name: Invalid Sender Account Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found with 'Sender not found'

tests.name: Invalid Receiver Account Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found with 'Receiver not found'

tests.name: Duplicate Transaction ID (Idempotency Guard)
tests.expected: HTTP 409 Conflict with 'Duplicate transaction'
tests.actual: HTTP 409, error: 'Duplicate transaction: A transaction with this transaction_id already exists.'

tests.name: Self-Transfer Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Sender and receiver cannot be the same account'
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Sender and receiver cannot be the same account.'

tests.name: Transaction History Ledger Verification
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, list containing recorded debit transactions with audit metadata

tests.name: Minimum Valid Amount Boundary (₹1.00)
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, successful transfer of exact minimum allowed amount ₹1.00

tests.name: Sub-Minimum Amount Boundary (₹0.50)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Minimum transfer amount is ₹1.00'
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Minimum transfer amount is ₹1.00 (100 paise).'

tests.name: Zero Amount Boundary (₹0.00)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Transfer amount must be greater than zero'
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Transfer amount must be greater than zero.'

tests.name: Negative Amount Boundary (-₹50.00)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting negative currency transfer
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Transfer amount must be greater than zero.'

tests.name: Exact Available Balance Boundary
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, full wallet balance transferred leaving exactly ₹0.00

tests.name: Amount Exceeding Available Balance (+₹1.00 Boundary)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Insufficient wallet balance'

tests.name: Extremely Large Transaction Amount Boundary
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejected due to upper limit cap or insufficient funds
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Transfer amount exceeds maximum single transaction limit of ₹5,00,000.'

tests.name: Missing Required Field (Amount Omitted)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Missing required fields'

tests.name: Empty/Whitespace Transaction ID Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting whitespace-only transaction ID
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'transaction_id must be a non-empty string.'

tests.name: Invalid Data Type (Boolean Amount)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting boolean for currency amount
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Invalid amount format. Must be a numeric value, not a boolean.'

tests.name: Non-Numeric String Amount Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with 'Must be a valid numeric value'
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Invalid amount format. Must be a valid numeric value.'

tests.name: Malformed JSON Payload Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting malformed JSON body
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Malformed JSON payload. Please provide valid JSON.'

tests.name: Decimal Precision Boundary (Max 2 Decimal Places / Paise)
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting fractional paise with >2 decimal places
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Invalid decimal precision. Transfer amount cannot have more than 2 decimal places (paise).'

tests.name: Special Characters / Symbols in Amount Rejection
tests.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, rejecting non-numeric symbols in amount
tests.actual: HTTP 400, error: 'Invalid amount format. Must be a valid numeric value.'

tests.name: Flask API & SQLite Database Handshake
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, database status 'connected'

tests.name: User Accounts Directory & Schema Mapping
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, returns user records with user_id, name, balance_paise, balance_rupees

tests.name: End-to-End Balance Synchronization Cycle
tests.expected: Sender decremented by exact ₹300, Receiver incremented by exact ₹300 in SQLite

tests.name: Transaction Ledger Persistence Verification
tests.expected: Transaction record persisted to SQLite ledger and retrievable via history API

tests.name: Failed Transfer State Non-Pollution
tests.expected: Sender balance remains strictly unchanged after rejected transaction

tests.name: Conservation of Total Money (Invariant Sum)

scenario.rule: Sum of all account balances before transfer == Sum after transfer

tests.expected: System balance conserved: ₹7000.00 == ₹7000.00

tests.name: Non-Negative Balance Constraint Verification

scenario.rule: balance_paise >= 0 constraint enforced for every user account

tests.expected: Zero accounts with negative balances across the entire database

tests.name: Transaction History Isolation for Failed Requests
tests.expected: No SUCCESS transaction row created in database for rejected request
tests.actual: Zero database rows found for failed transaction ID (isolated)

tests.name: Ledger Debit-Credit Conservation & Foreign Keys
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, is_consistent: true, orphan_transactions: 0

tests.name: Atomic Rollback on Transaction Interruption

scenario.scenario: Simulated mid-flight failure during fund debit

tests.expected: conn.rollback() executed successfully; balance restored to pre-transaction value

tests.name: Single Read API Response-Time Benchmark (< 200ms)
tests.expected: Response time <= 200ms (Observed: 0.48 ms)

tests.name: Sequential Latency Stability (Burst 5 requests, Avg < 250ms)
tests.expected: Average latency <= 250ms across sequential requests

tests.name: Atomic Transfer API Write Latency (< 300ms)
tests.expected: Atomic SQLite transaction write completes under 300ms

tests.name: SQL Injection Protection in User Identifier
tests.expected: HTTP 404 Not Found via parameterized query without leaking database records

tests.name: SQL Injection Neutralization in Transaction ID
tests.expected: Parameterized query handles SQL syntax literally; users table intact and unaffected

tests.name: Error Response Sanitization (No Internal Traceback Leakage)
tests.expected: Clean JSON error response without exposing Python stack traces or SQLite schemas

tests.name: CORS Preflight & Security Response Headers
tests.expected: HTTP 200 OK, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

tests.name: XSS Script Tag Neutralization in User Creation
tests.expected: HTTP 201 Created, script tags properly sanitized/HTML-escaped in storage
